Photoshoot 1.4.0 fixes the camera going black after viewing a photo and turns four-photo mode into a real photo booth.

- **Fixed: black camera after viewing a photo.** Using an effect, taking a picture, viewing it and going back could leave a black screen until the app was reopened. That no longer happens.
- **A countdown before every photo.** Four-photo mode now counts down before each of the four pictures, so you have time to change pose. Press Escape to stop a countdown.
- **A different effect for each photo.** Click a numbered slot above the picture to choose that photo's effect, or Shuffle for four different ones. Each slot lights up as its turn comes, and the photo drops into it.
- **Choose your print.** After four photos, pick a 2×2 grid, the classic strip with the date, a wide row, or one big photo over three, on white, black or cream paper. Then save, share, or retake.
- **Movies play when you open them**, and show their first frame in the tray.
- **Tips for first-timers** point at the main controls one at a time. Settings → Help lists every shortcut and can show the tips again.
- **Polish.** Drawn icons everywhere, livelier motion and press feedback, and on the web Share opens your device's share sheet.

Download `Photoshoot-1.4.0-x64.exe` for the Windows 10/11 installer or `Photoshoot-1.4.0-portable.exe` for the portable app. SHA-256 hashes are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

These executables are unsigned, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning (choose More info, then Run anyway). No signed or notarised macOS release is included.

[Open the browser app](https://photoshoot-yeegz.web.app/app/).
